name: TencentDB Agent Memory (Remote)
description: Remote TencentDB Agent Memory plugin for OpenClaw — connects directly to a central TencentDB MemoryCore & Panel cluster for multi-agent fleet memory, bidirectional turn sync, and prefetch recall.

coreUrl.label: TencentDB Core URL
coreUrl.help: Base URL of TencentDB MemoryCore (:8420) for L0-L3 semantic search and skill recall.

importUrl.label: TencentDB Import URL
importUrl.help: Base URL of TencentDB MemoryPanel (:8125) for turn synchronization (/api/v1/chat-memory/import).

knowledgeUrl.label: TencentDB Knowledge URL
knowledgeUrl.help: Base URL of TencentDB MemoryKnowledge (:8424) for Team-Wiki and Code-Graph search.

userKey.label: User API Key
userKey.help: TencentDB Access Key from .admin-key or personal user account.

teamId.label: Team ID
teamId.help: Team identifier / tenant namespace in TencentDB.

agentId.label: Agent ID
agentId.help: Unique Agent ID container assigned to this OpenClaw instance.

autoRecall.label: Auto-Recall
autoRecall.help: Automatically prefetch relevant conversations and skills before each agent turn.

autoCapture.label: Auto-Capture
autoCapture.help: Automatically stream completed turns to the central TencentDB cluster after each agent turn.

scoreThreshold.label: Recall Score Threshold
scoreThreshold.help: Minimum similarity score (0.0 - 1.0) for memories to be injected into context.

maxRecallResults.label: Max Recall Results
maxRecallResults.help: Maximum number of conversation memories to inject into prompt context.
